comparator.name: Biology
comparator.sourceNotes: The English-taught degree combines 60 EC in year one, 90 EC in the selected major and a 30 EC minor. In this example the major includes a 15 EC supervised research project.
components: Laboratory Research Skills in Life Sciences
Take this course alongside Theoretical Research Skills in Life Sciences.
Theoretical Research Skills in Life Sciences
Take this course alongside Laboratory Research Skills in Life Sciences.
Choose Medical Structural Biology or Integrative Neuroscience. This example takes Medical Structural Biology.
Biology & Society: Ethical and Professional Aspects
Choose an eligible 30 EC minor. Some life sciences minors include the Minor Congress within those credits.
Choose Bioanalytical and Omics Techniques or Biotechnology. This example takes Bioanalytical and Omics Techniques.
Earn at least 90 EC outside the minor, including all first-year courses, and take Practical Carrousel before starting the project.

routeSelection.basis: Molecular Life Sciences is the first major listed in the official course catalog. The example uses the Medical Structural Biology option and one elective from each of the three teaching blocks before the project.

alternatives.label: Molecular, Cellular and Biomedical Biology
alternatives.labelReason: The title reflects the emphasis of the courses and the methods they develop.
alternatives.concept: Explore how cells function and how molecular changes contribute to disease. Study biochemistry, genetics, immunity and physiology, and build skills in laboratory methods, programming and data analysis.
progression: Cell biology and biochemistry precede Life Science Laboratory. Physiology and biochemistry precede Pharmacology. Programming and data foundations precede machine learning and advanced image and neural-network methods.

alternatives.label: Ecology, Evolution and Conservation
alternatives.labelReason: The title reflects the emphasis of the courses and the methods they develop.
alternatives.concept: Study how organisms evolve and interact with their environments. Combine biodiversity, conservation and marine biology with Earth observation, soil and water science, and field and laboratory work.
progression: Sustainability and data foundations precede Earth Observation. Biodiversity and ecosystem study precede marine biology. The introductory sustainability sequence precedes advanced Earth resource study.
alternatives.distinctness: This plan differs from the molecular plan by 15 courses and from the other focused plan by 19 courses in each direction.

alternatives.label: Brain, Behavior and Biological Health
alternatives.labelReason: The title reflects the emphasis of the courses and the methods they develop.
alternatives.concept: Study how brain systems and bodily processes shape behavior and health. Combine neuroscience, physiology and pharmacology with psychology, development, experimental methods and research synthesis.
progression: Brain and behavior foundations precede perception and higher-order neuroscience. Physiology and biochemistry precede Pharmacology. Psychopathology precedes psychological assessment and therapy, and experimental methods precede research synthesis.
alternatives.distinctness: This plan differs from the molecular plan by 9 courses and from the other focused plan by 19 courses in each direction.

core: Molecular and cellular biology, genetics, microbiology and biochemistry
Organismal physiology, health and disease mechanisms
Ecology, evolution, biodiversity and environmental biology
Biostatistics, modelling, programming and biological data analysis
Laboratory, field and independent biological research
adjacent: Climate, marine life, conservation and environmental change
Biomedical biology, disease and health research
questions: How do living systems function from molecules and cells to organisms and ecosystems?
How do climate change and human activity affect biodiversity and ecosystems?
How do biological processes produce health, disease, behaviour and brain function?

candidates.label: Ecology, Evolution and Conservation
candidates.assessment: The ecology direction develops biodiversity, evolutionary reasoning, ecosystem processes, marine biology and environmental analysis, including field and spatial tools.

candidates.label: Brain, Behavior and Biological Health
candidates.assessment: The neuroscience direction combines neural function and higher cognition with social and clinical psychology, physiological foundations and experimental evidence. The molecular plan already takes the biomedical direction through immunity, genetics and molecular disease.

blocks: Both introduce cell structure, inheritance and molecular mechanisms of life.
Both study how organ systems function and maintain physiological balance.
Both study the structure and function of biomolecules, including proteins, carbohydrates and lipids.
Groningen combines cell biology with microscopy. UCR covers cell structures, signaling and division in Molecular Cell Biology.
Both develop practical microbiology skills. UCR also uses protein and DNA techniques.
Both examine inheritance, gene regulation and genetic variation. UCR also studies how these mechanisms contribute to disease.
Groningen offers a dedicated cancer course. UCR covers neoplasia within a broader course on pathology and genetics.
Groningen integrates cell biology with immunology. UCR studies these subjects in separate courses.
Both study heredity, adaptation and evolutionary processes. Groningen also covers ecological foundations in this course.
Both examine how brain function relates to behavior. UCR includes comparative neuroanatomy.
Both develop academic skills such as working with sources and communicating evidence.
Both teach Python and computational problem-solving. Groningen uses biology applications.
Groningen analyzes biological sequence and related data. UCR introduces general data analysis and uses bioinformatics tools in the laboratory course.
Groningen models biological processes. UCR teaches numerical methods and machine learning with broader applications.
Both use statistical inference to analyze empirical research. UCR applies these methods to human behavior.
Groningen examines professional and ethical issues in biology. UCR studies ethical reasoning in a broader course.
Groningen offers a separate course in microbiology. UCR includes bacterial identification and culture in its Life Science Laboratory.
Groningen offers a separate course in metabolism. UCR studies energy pathways in Biochemistry.
Groningen develops laboratory research skills in a paired sequence with theoretical research.
Groningen develops theoretical research skills alongside the laboratory course.
Groningen studies the structure of biological molecules and its medical relevance.
Both study immune recognition and responses. UCR also examines how pathogens interact with host defenses.
Groningen offers a separate course in the organic chemistry of biological molecules.
Groningen combines specialist practicals before the major research project.
Groningen develops enzyme kinetics and thermodynamics. UCR introduces enzyme function and regulation in Biochemistry.
Groningen studies microbial communities and their interactions with hosts.
Choose an eligible 30 EC minor. Some life sciences minors include the Minor Congress within those credits.
Groningen offers an advanced course in techniques for studying molecules and large biological datasets.
Groningen studies epigenetic regulation and gene editing. UCR covers gene regulation and genetic technologies within broader courses.
Groningen requires a supervised project in the major. The UCR comparison shows optional independent research separately.

selection.assessment: The selected Molecular Life Sciences route supports a strong molecular and biomedical closest response. Ecology/evolution and behaviour/neuroscience are separately evidenced by current formal majors and target-specific interests, produce substantively different curricula and pass pairwise mechanical distinctness. Production stops at three alternatives.

notes.text: Groningen develops a specialist sequence in molecular life sciences, including structural biology, microscopy and omics, followed by a required 15 EC project. The UCR options combine biology with data analysis, environmental science or psychology.

audience.programmeDescription: This English-taught degree studies living systems from molecules and cells to organisms and ecosystems.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The Groningen example follows Molecular Life Sciences. The UCR options emphasize molecular and biomedical biology, ecology and conservation, or brain and behavior.
